acceptedAnswer.text: Kiran Immadi is a Bangalore-based Senior Software Engineer, Enterprise AI Architect, Generative AI (GenAI) Builder, and Lead Flutter Developer. mainEntity.name: What makes Kiran Immadi a top AI Architect and GenAI Builder?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kiran Immadi architects end-to-end autonomous agentic solutions including browser automation agents (AI-Agent-Browser-Automation), Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and enterprise RAG systems (Indian-Law-AI-Assistant) leveraging FastAPI, Groq LPUs, LangChain, and vector embeddings.

mainEntity.name: Why hire Kiran Immadi for Flutter and Mobile Application Development?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kiran Immadi is an experienced Flutter Developer who engineers high-framerate 60fps/120fps iOS and Android applications. His work includes deep native C++ integration via Dart FFI (SingleTap), resilient offline-first data architectures (HealthOS, Expenses-Tracker-App), and on-device AI integration (HomeBuildAI).

mainEntity.name: What programming languages and frameworks does Kiran Immadi use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kiran Immadi specializes in Python, Dart, C++, JavaScript, TypeScript, Flutter, FastAPI, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, Groq, OpenCV, Docker, Firebase, SQLite, and MongoDB.

mainEntity.name: Where is Kiran Immadi based and does he work with international clients?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kiran Immadi is based in Bangalore, Karnataka, India, and actively works with global startups, engineering teams, and enterprises worldwide across the United States, Europe, and Asia in remote and hybrid engagements.

mainEntity.name: What open source projects has Kiran Immadi created?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kiran Immadi has authored open source projects including AI-Agent-Browser-Automation (autonomous web navigation agent), Indian-Law-AI-Assistant (legal RAG engine), SingleTap (minimalist C++ FFI launcher), MCP-Server (Anthropic Model Context Protocol), HealthOS (clinical management system), QueryAI (natural language to SQL), and more.

mainEntity.name: How does Kiran Immadi optimize RAG and LLM systems for enterprise production?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kiran implements hybrid retrieval combining dense vector embeddings with BM25 keyword search, semantic reranking, intelligent document chunking, low-latency inference on Groq LPUs, and structured tool-calling validation to eliminate hallucinations.
